## bot-translate
Shared he/ru/en translation for the bot (gallery alt text, YouTube title/description, schedule notes). Same model, rules and glossary as news Translate; glossary read live from content/glossary.json.
Input: `fields{name: text}`, optional `src_lang`, `context`, `limits{name: maxChars}`. Output: `{src_lang, tr{he,ru,en}, warnings}`.
